d: Join Snoonu's Commercial Team in Oman and take ownership of our growing partner network across the region. As an Account Manager, you will be the main point of contact for our restaurant and retail partners — nurturing relationships, driving performance, and ensuring every brand on Snoonu is set up for success. This is the role for someone who is passionate about building long-term partnerships and turning good relationships into great business results.
q: 2–4 years of experience in account management, partner success, or client relationship roles
Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a consultative approach to managing partners
Data-driven mindset,comfortable analyzing performance metrics and translating them into actionable recommendations
Highly organized, proactive, and able to manage a large portfolio of accounts simultaneously
Fluent in Arabic and English, written and spoken
Prior experience in a delivery platform, super app, or e-commerce environment
Familiarity with performance dashboards, CRM tools, or data analytics platforms
An existing network in the F&B or retail industry in Oman

d: Bleems is looking for a Back-End Developer to build and maintain the systems and APIs that power our online gifting marketplace. You’ll also contribute to website development, working with web and mobile developers to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable customer experiences.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
At least 4 years of back-end development experience.
Strong proficiency in C# and .NET Core, with hands-on experience in EF Core and Microsoft SQL Server.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services.
Experience with RESTful APIs, API security, and payment integrations.
Familiarity with Next.js is a plus.
Knowledge of Git, CI/CD, and Agile development practices.
Experience with e-commerce or marketplace platforms.
r: Design, build, and maintain back-end applications and RESTful APIs using C# and .NET Core.
Develop and maintain website features in collaboration with front-end developers, including product browsing, checkout, and order tracking.
Improve website and application performance, scalability, and security.
Write clean, maintainable code and use Entity Framework Core (EF Core) for data access.
Review code and resolve technical issues.
Manage and optimize Microsoft SQL Server and Azure SQL Managed Instance, including SQL queries and database operations.
Manage database migrations and maintain data integrity.
Develop and integrate APIs for the Bleems website and mobile apps, including integrations with third-party services.
Integrate of secure payment gateways and reliable order processing.
Deploy, manage, and monitor applications using Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure Key Vault, and Application Insights.
Maintain CI/CD pipelines and troubleshoot performance issues.
Test, debug, and troubleshoot back-end services, website features, and integrations.
Maintain technical documentation for APIs, services, and deployment processes.
